LanguageData.PMP.Champion.ChargeDesc: Records incoming damage before adaptation. The next hit that actually deals damage adds and consumes the entire charge. Fully absorbed hits preserve it.
LanguageData.PMP.Champion.Passive: Passive effect; no manual activation required
LanguageData.PMP.Champion.ThrowDesc: Select a nearby hostile or factionless building/item, then a direction. On collision, the object and nearby buildings/pawns each receive vanilla blunt damage with base damage equal to half the object's maximum hit points. Friendly fire is possible.
